records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $43.7 million, or 40.7%, to $151.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2022 as compared to $107.6 million in the same period in the prior year.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The $43.7 million increase in net sales was driven by $25.0 million related to price and mix and $18.7 million due to volume, including refilling our trade inventory.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The $119.9 million increase in net sales was driven by $62.5 million due to volume, including refilling our trade inventory, and $57.4 million due to price and mix.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Thus far, it appears that most major retailers have reflected that in their shelf prices and to date, we have not seen an adverse effect on our growth rates.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: As part of the Company's increased focus on cash, we are changing how we report Adjusted Gross Profit, Adjusted SG&A, and Adjusted EBITDA.
